sources.quote: BR-220 at TO1 for STL has one approved material source: Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese).
Meccanica C S.p.A. holds approvals for: BR-180 (TO1, STL); BR-310 (TO2, CLM).

findings.why: The probation was revoked on 2026-11-05 (EML-SQ-2026-1105), so supplier standing is not the problem. The approved source list is a controlled record. It covers BR-220 at TO1 for STL and names only Alluminio B. Meccanica C (Chieri) has no approval for BR-220. Its approvals are for BR-180 (TO1, STL) and BR-310 (TO2, CLM). Approval is per part, plant and customer, so those do not carry over to BR-220. Lifting the probation does not give Meccanica C a part approval. The audit email itself says the audit concerns the supplier, not individual parts. BR-220 billet from Meccanica C therefore has no current source release.
